ludoRuleText: Roll a six to leave base. Reach home with an exact roll. Three sixes in a row forfeit your turn.
checkersRulesText: American checkers: move one square diagonally forward. Capture by jumping an adjacent opponent piece into the empty square beyond. Captures are mandatory, and multi-jumps continue while more captures are available. Reach the far row to become a king.
checkersMandatoryCapture: Kings move and capture both forward and backward. You win when your opponent has no pieces or no legal move.
blockedRound: The round is blocked. The player with fewer pips wins.
freeTableNote: Practice chips are free and have no cash value.
